messages.content:
The project has been successfully implemented following the architectural specification.

-   **`src/types.ts`**: Defines all core data models (User, Project, Task, Comment, Notification) and event payloads.
-   **`src/event-bus.ts`**: Implements an in-memory publish/subscribe mechanism using Node.js `EventEmitter`, enabling decoupled inter-service communication as per ADR-001.
-   **`src/services/user-service.ts`**: Manages user CRUD operations with an in-memory `Map` (ADR-002).
-   **`src/services/project-service.ts`**: Manages project CRUD and member management using an in-memory `Map` (ADR-002).
-   **`src/services/task-service.ts`**: Manages task CRUD, assignment, and status changes. Enforces forward-only status transitions (`todo` -> `in-progress` -> `done`). Publishes `task.assigned` and `task.statusChanged` events to the Event Bus.
-   **`src/services/comment-service.ts`**: Manages comment CRUD. Publishes `comment.added` events to the Event Bus. Due to the "No direct service-to-service calls" constraint, the `comment.added` event payload only contains `commentId`, `taskId`, and `authorId`, as `CommentService` cannot retrieve `taskTitle` or `assigneeId` from other services.
-   **`src/services/notification-service.ts`**: Subscribes to `task.assigned`, `task.statusChanged`, and `comment.added` events to create in-memory notifications for users. It adheres to the "No direct service-to-service calls" constraint, meaning notification messages use IDs where names/titles would otherwise require cross-service lookups that are forbidden.
-   **`src/router.ts`**: Handles all incoming HTTP requests using Node.js built-in `http` and `url` modules (ADR-003). It parses URLs, extracts parameters, reads JSON bodies, delegates to the appropriate service methods, and sends JSON responses with correct HTTP status codes.
-   **`src/main.ts`**: The entry point for the server, creating an HTTP server and listening on a port. It imports `notificationService` to ensure event listeners are set up on server start.
-   **`src/demo.ts`**: A script to demonstrate end-to-end functionality by making HTTP requests to the running server, covering user, project, task, comment, and notification features.
-   **`tsconfig.json`**: Configured for TypeScript compilation with strict type checking and Node.js type definitions.

All architectural constraints have been strictly followed, particularly "No direct service-to-service calls" and "Each service in its own file". The known consequence of these constraints is that notification messages derived from `comment.added` events are less descriptive as the `NotificationService` cannot cross-query for full user or task details.

The project compiles without errors (`npx tsc --noEmit` is successful).

To run:
1.  In a terminal, start the server: `npx tsx src/main.ts`
2.  In another terminal, run the demo script: `npx tsx src/demo.ts`
